title: Tenant-scoped poisoning detection and isolated recovery playbook
creator: Aditi Rao
description: After a capacity-surge incident in which tenant-shared prefix cache entries became corrupted under concurrent resharding, we observed cross-tenant request contamination and incorrect responses for ~6% of requests to affected models. This ticket contains the detection heuristics, runbook for isolated recovery, and a staged remediation plan to prevent future tenant-scoped poisonings without regressing latency SLOs.
impact: Approximately 6% request error/incorrect-output rate for affected traffic during the surge window; no customer data exfiltration detected. Incident triggered emergency capacity shedding which increased tail latency by ~45% for 27 minutes.
root_cause: A race between the new fast-reshard path and background compaction where stale prefix references were reinserted with mismatched namespace metadata. The existing cache checksum and namespace tags were insufficiently granular to prevent cross-tenant lookup of reinserted entries during the narrow reshard window.
timeline: 2025-02-06 03:12 UTC: Autoscaler initiated fast reshard to absorb traffic spike
2025-02-06 03:13-03:19 UTC: Background compaction and reshard overlapped on shard B, race reinserted stale prefix objects with old namespace header
2025-02-06 03:20 UTC: Error budget alarms triggered; customers observed incorrect completions
2025-02-06 03:25 UTC: Emergency traffic reroute to isolated dedicated pool; mitigation reduced cross-tenant contamination
2025-02-06 04:00 UTC: Full mitigation validated and system returned to normal
decisions: Add tenant-scoped namespace versioning to cache keys (tenantID:namespace:version:prefixHash) to make stale reinserts non-lookupable by other tenants
Introduce per-shard compaction locks that delay reshard fast-path handoff by up to 250ms when compaction metadata is in-flight to avoid races
Deploy a lightweight checksum and LRU-gen counter at read time to detect likely-poisoned entries and trigger isolate-and-scan flow
Avoid full cache invalidation as first response; prefer targeted tenant-alias fencing and scan to limit latency and cold-start cost
action_items: ENG-274839-A: Implement namespace versioning in cache key schema and add migration adapter (owner: Marcus Chen, estimate: 5). Deliverable: new key schema + compatibility adapter in runtime-1.20 branch.
ENG-274839-B: Add a read-time lightweight checksum + LRU-gen counter with configurable sensitivity (owner: Priya Nair, estimate: 3). Deliverable: feature flag gated telemetry and perf dashboard.
ENG-274839-C: Implement per-shard compaction handoff guard and benchmark worst-case latency (owner: Daniel Ortega, estimate: 2). Deliverable: microbench results and CI regression test.

ENG-274839-D: Author an automated isolated recovery runbook: detect -> fence tenant -> scan shard -> scrub affected entries -> un-fence (owner: SRE oncall rotation, estimate: 3). Deliverable: playbook + Slack runbook link + PagerDuty schedule update.

ENG-274839-E: Telemetry spike: create poisoning-detection alerts and dashboards showing 'cross-namespace lookups', 'checksum-mismatch rate', and 'reshard overlap events' (owner: Observability team, estimate: 2). Deliverable: Grafana dashboard + Prometheus alerts.

ENG-274839-F: Add an e2e disaster test simulating fast reshard + compaction overlap in staging and gate on zero cross-tenant contamination (owner: Testing infra, estimate: 4). Deliverable: test harness and CI job.

ENG-274839-G: Run targeted canary rollout to 5% of traffic with the new key schema and checksum enabled, monitor error/latency for 48 hours before broad rollout (owner: Release Engineering, estimate: 1). Deliverable: canary report and rollback plan.
ENG-274839-H: Update ops docs and customer-facing incident FAQ about cache scoping and mitigation steps (owner: Solutions Docs, estimate: 1). Deliverable: docs update link and PR.
ENG-274839-I: Post-deploy incident drill scheduled to validate runbook within 2 weeks of rollout (owner: SRE lead, estimate: 1). Deliverable: drill report and playbook updates.
dependencies: OBS-1182 (prometheus exporter hook for checksum metrics)
comments: 2025-02-11 Marcus Chen: Spike finished for namespace-versioning; initial perf delta is +1.8% p50 token latency in microbench. We need to optimize key serialization to reduce overhead.
2025-02-12 Priya Nair: Checksum prototype is in feature-flagged state. Observability team requested lower sampling to limit cardinality. We'll add adaptive sampling by tenant activity.
2025-02-14 Daniel Ortega: Compaction handoff guard implemented behind flag. Benchmarks show worst-case increase of 200ms during heavy compaction but avoids corruption in stress tests.
2025-02-18 Observability: Added 'cross-namespace lookups' metric; initial alerts tuned to the observed incident baseline. Need to finalize thresholds after canary.
2025-02-20 PM review (Lena Brooks): Prioritize runbook authoring and canary gating. Asked to defer global key migration until we confirm rollback path is sub-1h.
2025-02-24 SRE lead (Diego Ramos): Scheduled the recovery drill for 2025-03-05; will coordinate with release engineering for a safe window.
notes: Tradeoffs considered: full cache flush would eliminate cross-tenant contamination fastest but causes heavy cold-start and cost for customers. The chosen approach favors tenant-fencing + targeted scrub to balance customer impact and risk. Security review requested due to tenant isolation surface change.
audit: Created by Aditi Rao; initial triage with SRE, Observability, and Runtime leads on 2025-02-10. Ticket scoped to deliverables that avoid full-cache invalidation and minimize tail-latency regression.
